name: Islam
subtitle: Submission to the one God, in the tradition of the prophets

adherents.basis: Enumerated by Pew. 25.6% of world population. Supersedes the v5 stat box figure of 1.9 bn.

overview.body: Islam holds that God is one, without partner or likeness, and that the [[quran|Quran]] is God's final revelation, delivered through Muhammad, the last in a line of prophets that includes Abraham, Moses, and Jesus. The believer's life is structured by five obligatory practices, from daily prayer to the pilgrimage at Mecca.

origins.body: According to Islamic tradition, revelation began in 610 CE in a cave outside Mecca and continued for twenty-three years. The community's migration to Medina in 622, the [[hijra|Hijra]], marks year one of the Islamic calendar. By Muhammad's death in 632, most of the Arabian Peninsula had entered the new polity.

core_beliefs.body: At the center is [[tawhid]], the absolute oneness of God. Faith is classically summarized in six articles: God, the angels, the revealed books, the prophets, the Day of Judgment, and divine decree.

misconceptions.correction: In Islamic teaching, worship is directed to God alone. Muhammad is revered as the final prophet and moral exemplar, and is not held to be divine; venerating him as such would contradict tawhid itself.
